json.task: I need to set up a few automated workflows. First, I'll create an executor to pull new support tickets from Zendesk, summarize them with AI, and post to a Slack channel. Then, I'll build another to monitor a GitHub repo for new PRs, extract details, and update a Notion database. Finally, I'll set up a scheduled task to generate a weekly sales report from Stripe and email it. After that, I want to organize these by adding custom tags and then filter them to see only my 'critical' automations.
json.core_job: Create, run, and manage automated workflows.
